does: Rolls a damage formula's dice on the damage roll stream through RollDiceWithBoosts, so that the damage pin bounds each die; called by the deal-damage functor's path and by the AI's scoring of stats functors.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the host's PlayerDamage roll stream NumRolls: in a fair melee hit for 4 (dagger 1d4 pinned at 1, + 3) two draws (+0x105AAE3) in the frame of the damage, both returning through +0x10713AF of this function into +0x36E9347 (+0x36E8A80), one from stats::DealDamageFunctor::ApplyDamage (+0x36EA93B), one from +0x36EBCB0 (+0x36EC3FC); in a miss one draw, through +0x36EBCB0 only
The count write of the PlayerDamage stream after a weapon attack returns through +0x10713AF inside this function, called from +0x36E9347
The formula is rolled through the roll with boosts with no difficulty
